source: realistic muscle training and has different multiples to each stage you get to and pets that are OP that you obtain with money when you beat boss goons when you have the right amount of strength and with the pets it has gives you a power boost when training and different worlds once you beat the final boss of the previous world that you were in and the amount of would there are, are 10 but it gets harder and harder in different worlds

image_prompt.text: The shop zone where pets are bought with money and where every player keeps coming back
A barrier into the next world that opens once the previous world's final boss is beaten
Walkable circulation chaining the shop to the training areas and the boss ground
Muscle training stations the player works at repeatedly to build strength
realistic gym equipment - weights, benches, machines - laid out across the training area
ten worlds in sequence, each visually distinct and harder than the last

layout_placement.text: The training station volume the player stands in to lift and gain strength
Where the boss goons appear to be fought, gated behind a strength requirement

notes: Ten sequentially unlocked worlds are almost certainly separate maps, which would be P4, but Simulation has no multi-map shape to express it so the route is emitted as P0.
Action was loaded as a secondary genre only for the boss NPC origin.
Strength thresholds, stage multipliers and pet power boosts are the spine of the prompt and none of them have a field here.

open_questions.ask: The first world is a realistic gym - what are the other nine worlds meant to look like?
How big is one world - a single gym floor, or an open area you walk across?

coverage_missing.ask: What distinguishes the ten worlds visually?
Are the worlds separate maps you teleport between, or one map you walk through?
Is beating the tenth world the end of the game?

answers.ask: The first world is a realistic gym - what are the other nine worlds meant to look like?
answers.answer: Keep all ten worlds as increasingly challenging realistic gym environments, such as larger commercial gyms and elite training facilities; do not add separate fantasy or sci-fi themes.

answers.ask: How big is one world - a single gym floor, or an open area you walk across?
answers.answer: Each world should be a single gym floor-sized area that players can walk across, keeping the map compact and focused on training, bosses, and pet purchases.
